readme_excerpt: OpenViking: The Context Database for AI Agents English / 中文 / 日本語 Website · Live Demo · GitHub · Issues · Docs 👋 Join our Community 📱 Lark Group · WeChat · Discord · X What is OpenViking OpenViking is an open-source context database for AI agents. It stores memories, resources, and skills as one virtual filesystem under the viking:// protocol, so an agent browses its own context with ls, tree, and find instead of querying a black-box vector store.
